## Candidate assessment references

Link matching internal and external reports with exact candidate and baseline. Record final
acceptance evidence separately from deployment authorization and actual delivery results.

## Decisions and revisions

Record settled choices, open questions, changed requirements with reasons, affected old assessments,
known issues and their project-selected dispositions. Preserve stable identities on rewording.
Saving this definition does not establish acceptance, READY, or delivery.
